business_problem: Sympower, a pioneering force in the energy sector, employs around 200 professionals and operates across various European countries. The company’s mission is crucial: managing approximately 2 gigawatts of flexible capacity to stabilize the electricity grid amid increasing energy transitions.
solution_summary: Sympower built its Databricks implementation around Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, Delta Sharing, Lakeflow Jobs. Sympower, a pioneering force in the energy sector, employs around 200 professionals and operates across various European countries. The company’s mission is crucial: managing approximately 2 gigawatts of flexible capacity to stabilize the electricity grid amid increasing energy transitions. Databricks SQL serves governed analytics, dashboards, and ad hoc queries for business users and operational teams. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Delta Sharing shares governed datasets with external partners and downstream consumers. Lakeflow Jobs schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and transformations. The solution also connects to API, so teams can work from a shared governed environment instead of disconnected tools.

data_flow: Source data is ingested into databricks, curated in Delta Lake tables, processed with Databricks compute and orchestration services, and served through analytics, semantic search, or model endpoints for downstream users and applications. It connects with API.
business_outcome: The adoption of the Databricks Data + AI Platform has not only streamlined their operational processes but also poised them for significant advances in how they manage and leverage data for electricity grid balancing. Their current migration to Unity Catalog emphasizes their commitment to leveraging cutting-edge technology to improve data governance and analytic capabilities.
